component-structure.description: Standard Fluent UI v9 component structure
component-structure.example: export const Component = React.forwardRef((props, ref) => { const state = useComponent_unstable(props, ref); useComponentStyles_unstable(state); return renderComponent_unstable(state); });

hook-pattern.example: export const useComponent_unstable = (props, ref) => { return { components: { root: 'div' }, root: slot.always(getIntrinsicElementProps('div', { ref, ...props }), { elementType: 'div' }) }; };

styles-pattern.example: const useStyles = makeStyles({ root: { display: 'flex', color: tokens.colorNeutralForeground1 } }); export const useComponentStyles_unstable = (state) => { const styles = useStyles(); state.root.className = mergeClasses(componentClassNames.root, styles.root, state.root.className); return state; };

types-pattern.example: export type ComponentSlots = { root: NonNullable<Slot<'div'>>; }; export type ComponentProps = ComponentProps<ComponentSlots>; export type ComponentState = ComponentState<ComponentSlots>;

inline-styles.description: Avoid inline styles, use makeStyles instead
inline-styles.good: const styles = makeStyles({ root: { color: tokens.colorStatusErrorForeground1, padding: tokens.spacingHorizontalS } });

hardcoded-values.description: Avoid hardcoded values, use design tokens

any-types.description: Avoid any types, use proper TypeScript types
